desc: Run the self-test comparing brute force vs candA/candB/candC on all permutations N≤7 and samples; collect any mismatch cases. (0 mismatches; samples 4/6/0 pass)

Implement the O(N log N) Fenwick version — process v=N..1, current position = original pos[v] minus count of placed larger elements to its left (Fenwick prefix query), bubble cost = arithmetic series sum of current 1-based indices cur..v-1; mark placed positions in the Fenwick.

Run the program with empty stdin to confirm the final Fenwick `solve` matches brute force: 0 exhaustive mismatches (N≤7), 0 random mismatches (N≤12), and samples print 4 / 6 / 0; also sanity-check runtime on a worst-case N=2×10⁵ reverse permutation.
Finalize: strip/keep self-test behind empty-stdin guard, ensure fast I/O and correct stdout answer for real input.
